claims.claim: The actual continuum tail primitive is uniformly L1 off thresholds in the frozen carrier band; exact bounded shape primitives retain its undamped component.

Given uniformly C2 slow test envelopes, the susceptibility/causal-slip approximation has O(epsilon^2) value and original-time derivative error through S epsilon^-2; epsilon^2 drives have O(epsilon^4) projected error.
At continuum threshold2 a linear envelope has an O(epsilon), not O(epsilon^2), residual; at the shape resonance the response is secular. These carriers are outside the frozen band.
Even at allowed base carrier0, a uniformly C1 but not uniformly C2 epsilon-dependent envelope can produce an order-one shape residual. C1-only control is insufficient.
